# International Association for the Fantastic in the Arts

> > The International Association for the Fantastic in the Arts (IAFA) is an academic organization dedicated to the interdisciplinary study of fantastic literature, film, art, and media, hosting the annual ICFA conference and publishing the Journal of the Fantastic in the Arts.

IAFA brings together scholars, writers, and artists to explore speculative fiction, fantasy, science fiction, horror, and related genres. The organization hosts both the International Conference on the Fantastic in the Arts (ICFA) and the Virtual Conference on the Fantastic in the Arts (VICFA), featuring prominent guests like Kim Bo-Young, Djuna, Jeff VanderMeer, and Ben Okri.

## Key Topics

- International Conference on the Fantastic in the Arts (ICFA)
- Virtual Conference on the Fantastic in the Arts (VICFA)
- Journal of the Fantastic in the Arts (JFA)
- Speculative fiction and fantasy literature
- Afrofuturism and climate change studies
- Horror literature and Gothic studies
- Science fiction scholarship
- Interdisciplinary fantastic arts studies
- Theory roundtables and academic discourse
- Call for papers and conference proposals
- Crawford Award for fantasy literature
- Embodied spirits and fantastic themes
- Academic journal publishing
- Conference presentations and panels

## Core Organization

- [IAFA Homepage](https://fantastic-arts.org): IAFA homepage featuring VICFA 2025 call & guests Kim Bo-Young, Djuna
- [Journal of the Fantastic in the Arts](https://fantastic-arts.org/jfa): JFA interdisciplinary journal covering fantastic arts since 1988
- [Journal Publications](https://fantastic-arts.org/publications): JFA publication info, editor Brian Attebery, published three times yearly
- [Contact IAFA](https://fantastic-arts.org/contact): Contact form for reaching IAFA association

## Conference Participation

- [Submit a Proposal to ICFA](https://fantastic-arts.org/icfa-submissions): ICFA 43 submission portal for conference paper proposals

## Calls for Papers & Related Conferences

- [MLA Panel: Hacking (In)security](https://fantastic-arts.org/2017/cfp-mla-panel-hacking-insecurity-rewiring-systems-through-genre): MLA 2018 panel CFP by Sagnika Chanda on genre fiction & insecurity
- [Techniques of the Fantastic Conference](https://fantastic-arts.org/2017/cfp-techniques-of-the-fantastic-ninth-annual-conference-of-the-gesellschaft-für-fantastikforschung): GfF 2018 conference CFP on fantastic techniques at Freiburg/Fribourg
- [Handbook to Horror Literature](https://fantastic-arts.org/2017/cfp-the-handbook-to-horror-literature-select-chapters-needed): Handbook to Horror Literature CFP by Corstorphine & Kremmel
